authentication_sequence.query: sequence by kater.tenant.id with maxspan=5m [any where event.code == "identity.authentication.failed" and user.target.id == "pseudo-user-1"] [any where event.code == "identity.authentication.failed" and user.target.id == "pseudo-user-1"] [any where event.code == "identity.authentication.succeeded" and user.id == "pseudo-user-1"]

privilege_export.query: sequence by kater.tenant.id, user.id with maxspan=5m [any where event.code == "identity.privilege.changed"] [any where event.code == "data.sensitive.exported"]

credential_reuse.query: sequence by kater.tenant.id, kater.target.id with maxspan=5m [any where event.code == "identity.credential.rotated"] [any where event.code == "identity.authentication.revoked_credential"]
